cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: No Tie Stands
cards.instruction: Turn every even outcome into a formal rematch with a new rule and a consequence for losing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Our cakes tied. Next round, blindfolded icing. Loser cleans the kitchen. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A tie is a perfectly good result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then it should survive a more informative test.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. We can compete over who persuades the other to bake.

mechanism: A formalizes a cake tie into blindfolded icing with cleanup stakes and changes the food to keep B willing to compete.
confusable: Unlike merely asking for another bake, A adds a new test and an explicit losing consequence to undo equality.
comparison: Iced biscuits and blindfolds differ from meal ratings and a tip penalty.
seedUse: D211-a tied cakes and kitchen cleaning; S02-a gives B icing choice and reduces the required baking.
